kpis.nom_fr: Part de l automobile dans Adhesive Technologies
kpis.nom_source: auto share of the overall portfolio
kpis.citation: If you go on the split, auto, in the meantime, is slightly less than 20% of the overall portfolio of Adhesive Technologies, while electronics and industrials each have a high single-digit percentage within our portfolio.

I also mentioned here the differentiation between combustion engines and the electronic-based vehicles where we have at least two times the higher potential than in the combustion engine, with roughly EUR 250 of net sales per car in that context.

On the firepower question, what our planning is that, after the conclusion also of the Stahl acquisition, i.e., end of the year, now we are going to see a leverage of 1.5x EBITA, roughly, and that stands well within the A category for the rating.
